title: San Juan watershed storms, October–November 2026
description: PRISM precipitation for the two late-2026 storms over the San Juan watershed (HUC 1408), the remnants of Hurricane Trudy in October and an atmospheric river on November 1–2, averaged into H3 hexagons and extruded by depth. Choose any run of days with the slider.
day_note: Each PRISM day is the 24 hours ending 12:00 UTC on its date: 6 a.m. to 6 a.m. MDT until the time change on Nov 1, then 5 a.m. to 5 a.m. MST.
source: PRISM 800 m daily precipitation, aggregated to H3 by cell center
